name: mise_tools
title: Mise
description: Search Tools, Install Tools(Globally), Outdated Tools, Prune Tools from mise registory
author: yss

commands.name: mise-search
commands.title: Search Tool
commands.description: Search tools from the mise registry and install (global) or activate them

commands.name: mise-outdated
commands.title: Show Outdated Tools
commands.description: Check outdated mise tools and upgrade them

commands.name: mise-installed
commands.title: Show Installed Tools
commands.description: List installed mise tools, show details, and uninstall them

commands.name: mise-prune
commands.title: Prune Unused Versions
commands.description: List prunable mise tool versions and remove them

preferences.name: miseBinaryPath
preferences.title: Mise Binary Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the mise executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
